title: The Rate Did Not Move. The Risk Did.
subtitle: RBI repo held at 5.25% with a neutral stance. A composite auto-component CFO still has to reprice the unhedged import book, the floating-rate interest line, and the hurdle rate before Wednesday's board.
category: Monetary Policy, Treasury Risk and CFO Judgment
description: HBS-style teaching case dated 5 October 2026. Public facts: BW CFO World reports the MPC held the repo at 5.25% and a neutral stance, described as the fourth consecutive pause after the February 2026 hold. August 2026 primary corridor remains repo 5.25%, SDF 5.00%, MSF and Bank Rate 5.50%. Commentary figures in weekend coverage: FY27 CPI 4.6%, core about 4.4%, GDP 6.7-6.9%, forex reserves close to $697 billion. Crisil, via Business Today on 4 October 2026, says a hike of up to 50 bp is largely manageable for India Inc. Governor Sanjay Malhotra at the Fifth Kautilya Economic Conclave: today's resilience may not imply tomorrow's immunity. Composite firm: Godavari Precision Components Ltd. Composite decision-maker: CFO Meera Kulkarni.
thumbnail: THE RATE DID NOT MOVE. THE RISK DID.
